sentences.text: Shri Eshaan Datt - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Madhur Shukla - Advocate for respondent No.1/EO
Learned counsel for the petitioners, by way of this petition, has raised objection with regard to registration of FIR against the petitioners under Sections 420 and 120-B of Indian Penal Code.

The case of the petitioners is that they are the license holder of liquour shop but according to the allegations made by respondent No.1, the liquour was being sold in their shop on a higher price than the price print as MRP on the bottle.
He submits that even otherwise, offence under Section 420 and 120- B of IPC is not made out against them.
Shri Shukla, learned counsel appearing for EOW, prays for time to seek instructions in the matter.

In the meantime, the respondent agency is directed to make a fair investigation in the matter and examine whether under the existing circumstances, offence under Sections 420 and 120-B of IPC is made out or not.
Till then, interim relief granted earlier to continue.
